source_text: 从前有个农夫嫌他种的禾苗长得慢，得到地里把禾苗一株株地拔高了一点。回家后他对 家人说：“今天可真把我累坏了！但我总算让禾苗一下子长高了。“他儿子到地里去一看，禾 苗都已死光了。 现在有些家长急于让孩子成功，往往步那个农夫的后尘，搞得孩子苦不堪言，却不见孩 子学业长进。这样的家长是否该对这个问题有所醒悟，让孩子自然成长呢？。
reference_translation: Once upon a time, there was a farmer who thought the seedlings he planted were growing too slowly. So he went to the field and pulled each seedling up a bit. When he got home, he said to his family, "I'm really exhausted today! But at least I've made the seedlings grow taller all at once." When his son went to the field, he found that all the seedlings had died. Nowadays, some parents are eager for their children to succeed and often follow in the footsteps of that farmer. As a result, their children suffer a great deal, but there is no improvement in their studies. Should such parents wake up to this problem and let their children grow naturally?
